assessment.summary: The four findings have separate owners and narrow enforcement points, so focused local controls are safer and cheaper than a new shared security subsystem.

nonNegotiables: Preserve Chrome extension HTTP and WebSocket access to local STT.
Preserve cached local model selection and current-caption translation.
assumptions: No measured API-cost, latency, or GPU-concurrency budget was supplied.
The local STT service remains loopback-only in normal operation.

openQuestions: Whether the 500-segment and 100000-character automatic pretranslation ceilings should become user-configurable after usage data exists.
Whether a published fixed extension ID will later justify an exact-origin allowlist instead of the Chrome extension scheme pattern.
